items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher says, come on. I play the set with Fletcher's band. So I'm getting two pays.

ctx.x: He'd come in town. Like we'd be at the Savoy, and Fletcher would be coming in to play the Savoy, and up there with Arthur Gibbs. So I have to switch from one band to the other band, play this with Arthur Gibbs' band. Fletcher says, come on. I play the set with Fletcher's band. So I'm getting two pays. (unintelligible).
Well, that suited Hawk very well.
